result.summary: Several visual/layout issues found: truncated restaurant names, a nearly invisible profile control, and awkward clipping on horizontal category chips and restaurant cards.

issues.description: Restaurant name in the Fastest near you row is truncated (“Trattoria Piccol”), so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size, or truncate with ellipsis after ensuring adequate card width; test with longer locale strings.

issues.description: Top-right profile/avatar control is a very light gray circle on a white background, making it almost invisible aside from the small red dot.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast (darker border/fill or a clear person icon) so the control meets visibility and accessibility expectations.

issues.description: Category chip row clips a partial chip on the right edge with no clear fade/affordance that the list scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding, a fade gradient, or a chevron so overflow scrolling is obvious and chips aren’t cut mid-control.

issues.description: Third “Fastest near you” card is heavily clipped at the screen edge, which can feel broken rather than like a carousel peek.
issues.suggestion: Tighten card width/spacing or show a clearer peek percentage so horizontal scroll is intentional and polished.

issues.description: Popular section’s lower card (pizza) is cut off mid-image at the bottom of the viewport with no strong scroll cue beyond the home indicator.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards aren’t awkwardly bisected when the page first loads.
